objective: Define a provider-neutral candidate market universe and canonical instrument taxonomy for Crypto + Forex tradables and cross-market context instruments.
scope: Define tradable vs context-only vs proxy classifications
Define bootstrap candidate universe for Crypto and Forex without selecting providers
Define context universe for Gold, Oil, USD index, Treasury yields, equity indices and volatility
Define liquidity/data-coverage eligibility rules for later expansion
Define Spot FX volume-proxy labeling requirements
Define crypto spot/perpetual/futures distinctions and chain metadata
Ground taxonomy rationale in current official/primary sources where available
out_of_scope: Determine legal eligibility by owner jurisdiction
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every registry instrument has a unique canonical_id
Tradable candidates are separated from context-only instruments
Spot FX volume fields require proxy/source/coverage labels
Crypto perpetual instruments preserve settlement/collateral/funding metadata requirements
Provider-specific aliases are not treated as canonical IDs
No production provider or broker is selected
security_tests: No provider access authority implied by taxonomy
evidence: CME Gold and WTI official product/contract documentation
ICE Brent and USDX official product documentation
U.S. Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve documentation
rollback: Revert the P01-A research artifacts and state/catalog reconciliation. No runtime or provider changes are involved.
definition_of_done: Bootstrap Crypto and Forex candidate universes are defined
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
